title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: psyc350data datasets can exported SPSS .sav files full metadata — variable labels, value labels, user-defined missing values. useful need work SPSS lab assignments.

title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: dataset export function. Just call file path: don’t provide path, file saved current working directory default name.
code: # Each dataset has a dedicated export function export_superman_sav("superman_data.sav") export_superman_smes_sav("superman_smes_data.sav") export_hot_ones_sav("hot_ones_data.sav") export_tip_jokes_sav("tip_jokes_data.sav") export_mcu_sav("mcu_data.sav") export_mock_jury_sav("mock_jury_data.sav") export_candy_sav("candy_data.sav") export_candy_simple_sav("candy_simple_data.sav") export_affairs_sav("affairs_data.sav") export_football_sav("football_data.sav")  # Save to a specific location export_superman_sav("~/Desktop/superman_data.sav") export_football_sav("~/Desktop/football_data.sav")

title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: can also use export_sav() dataset name:
code: # Save to your desktop export_sav("superman", path = "~/Desktop/superman_data.sav")  # Save to the current working directory (default) export_sav("mock_jury") # Creates: mock_jury_data.sav

title: Exporting Datasets to SPSS
text: Use export_all_sav() export every dataset : creates one .sav file per dataset:
code: # Create a folder with all .sav files export_all_sav(dir = "~/Desktop/PSYC350_SPSS/") PSYC350_SPSS/ ├── superman_data.sav ├── superman_smes_data.sav ├── hot_ones_data.sav ├── tip_jokes_data.sav ├── mcu_data.sav ├── mock_jury_data.sav ├── candy_data.sav ├── candy_simple_data.sav ├── affairs_data.sav └── football_data.sav
